verdict.rationale: ADK supports deploying agents as always-on, auto-scaling services (Cloud Run, Agent Runtime) and provides a workflow runtime for multi-step, deterministic execution with retries, state, and human-in-the-loop, which enables agents to run independently of a chat UI. However, there is no explicit evidence of scheduling, event/webhook triggers, or a dedicated 'background automation' feature that lets a user set-and-forget a recurring task. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger mechanisms, evidence of long-running unattended jobs, and independent confirmation that deployed agents actually run autonomously without user-initiated invocation.
